projects.title: Work
projects.subtitle: Selection of projects where I applied software engineering principles, clean architecture, and robust API design.

items.name: EduSpace
items.description: Enterprise platform for educational management with Clean Architecture, DDD, and CQRS. Developed two parallel versions (production + experimental) for comparative analysis and A/B testing as part of experimental design methodology.

image.mainAlt: EduSpace landing page: smart campus coordination for educational institutions, with a photograph of students.

items.name: Finance App
items.description: Corporate bond management system with financial calculation engine (TCEA/TREA, cash flows, schedules).

image.mainAlt: Finance App landing page with the headline about bonds calculated with precision and a sample bond summary.
image.detailAlt: Finance App landing page detail: a French method chart of interest and amortization beside a TCEA and TREA comparison.

items.name: Booking Platform (Italy)
items.description: Web booking platform with responsive UI, auth, and optimized NoSQL database.

image.mainAlt: Parco dei Colori home page: a child with a butterfly net in a garden in front of a glass dome.
image.detailAlt: Parco dei Colori visit types and rates, three options in euros, each with a Book Now button.

items.name: Kataleya Flowers
items.description: Website for a flower shop with 32 years of history in Lima. E-commerce with floral arrangement catalog, customer gallery, WhatsApp ordering integration, and location map.

image.mainAlt: Kataleya Flowers home page: a bicycle basket of sunflowers and daisies in a field of sunflowers.
image.detailAlt: Kataleya Flowers best sellers: sunflower bouquets wrapped in paper, with the catalog categories above them.

items.description: Leading online tech education platform in Spanish. Developing and maintaining the web application (courses, video player, progress tracking, user profiles) within the frontend team.
Peruvian software development and digital transformation company. Built a web booking platform for an Italian client with responsive UI, authentication system, and optimized NoSQL database design.

about.title: About
about.portraitAlt: Portrait of Andrés Torres, wearing glasses, a navy suit and a tie.
paragraphs: I'm in my eighth term of Software Engineering at Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas (UPC), in the top fifth of my class.
I start from the architecture: Clean Architecture, DDD and CQRS in real projects, REST APIs and data models designed for scale, and documentation alongside the code.
On EduSpace I was Tech Lead of a five-member team. I work in Scrum, with clear communication and a results-driven mindset.
My principle: build with architectural fundamentals, measure outcomes, and keep code maintainable to scale.
